accepted_input_states.raw_condition: at least one of xmag/ymag/zmag is non-zero and all are finite

xmag == ymag == zmag == 0. NOTE: this is NOT a documented MAVLink sentinel. It is treated as one by BOTH committed decoders, and the adapter says so in its own comment -- 'An all-zero triple is ABSENT, not a zero field. A real magnetometer never reads exactly zero on all three axes.' The contract records the decoders' reading, not a protocol guarantee.
no SCALED_IMU within 1.5x the nominal refresh period

allowed_merges.reason: as for the other families: past max_age both mean no current measurement.

forbidden_merges.needed_by: the heading_caution rule reasons over T['mag'] and fresh['mag'] (csia/runtime/failsafe.py). 'The autopilot is publishing SCALED_IMU and reporting no magnetometer' and 'the SCALED_IMU stream has stopped' are different vehicle conditions with different remedies, and both currently reach the core as the same silence.
a zero field vector must never be usable as a heading reference.

freshness.rule: a channel older than max_age is unusable and reported STALE

retention.rule: on an explicit absence report the retained field vector must be discarded
retention.citation: REQUIRED BY THIS CONTRACT; the committed adapter simply does not call _put, so the previous vector is retained and ages out.

sentinel_handling.rule: the absence report must be delivered with a reason
sentinel_handling.citation: REQUIRED BY THIS CONTRACT; ardupilot.py:143 has NO _reject_sentinel call on the else branch -- unlike GNSS and battery, this family records nothing at all.

diagnostic_visibility.rule: the reason a channel is unusable must reach a consumer that can act on it differently from any other reason
